mostWorthwhile.text: Building the onion of burning shells was most worthwhile: it made the coexistence of different burning regions inside one star easier to picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed compression attempts were repetitive and left the route forward unclear, particularly after compression had worked on earlier material.

surprise.text: Inspecting compression revealed that the oxygen-burning layers could advance further, even after they had helped form the onion of shells.

arbitrary.text: The onion of shells having no available combinations initially felt arbitrary, although it later combined with silicon-burning material to form the core.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the approaching collapse connects the star's newly made elements to later worlds; the explanations made the stages understandable without reducing them to simple reactions.
